# 15k FPS, 2 ms Reasoning Can It Prove Actions Usable on G1?

> **Current answer:** Cannot. The response indicates that the physical G1 bottleneck may be in contact dynamics and actuators, rather than frame rate in the generation frame; validation of retargeting, control period, joint limits, and real-time stability is required. At the time, the integrated robot version was not released, so the conclusion is unresolved.
